verdict.rationale: Swell doesn't offer a built-in natural-language command console, but it ships AI-specific tooling — a dedicated AI page describing a 'file contract, CLI and validate-deploy-verify loop', a public agent-skills repo installable in Claude Code, and schema-introspection endpoints — enabling an AI coding agent to be directed via natural language to build/manage stores. Runtime probes confirm the CLI installs and the skills repo exists, giving real substance beyond marketing copy. Missing for 10: a native end-user NL interface inside Swell itself, and independent (non-vendor) evidence that the agent-skill workflow reliably translates arbitrary NL requests into correct actions.
